mission: Phase 2 step A of the catalogue-gap request (owner 2026-10-26, perfectionist): an owner-gated ops-write runbook catalogue-import that runs the existing Bandai JP import engine (app.import_frozen_bandai_to_canonical_staging: print_import_planner plans, CanonicalImportApplier writes, every pin unchanged) inside the ops-write workflow. Fresh Bandai capture in the run (six-digit series pages, images for the scope's entries only, 1 req/s, honest User-Agent, stop on 401/403/429/451); named scopes in docs/agent/CATALOGUE_IMPORT_SCOPES.json; importer gains --series (coded scope, whole-snapshot sibling counts) and two keyword seams for the runbook (open_tunnel, wrapped by canonical_staging_target.ReroutedChecker around the real checker so only how the pinned staging Postgres is reached changes - its Railway TCP proxy - while every fingerprint, the revision check and the attestation stay the checker's; on_plan sees the plan before the applier). Plan SHA-256 over every whole planned print and its entry record; apply re-plans and refuses unless identical, re-checks quiet windows after the capture, and needs a Railway backup under 24 h. Independent review: FAIL (plan SHA coverage, log mask), then PASS WITH NITS after fixes. Uncoded products are reported against the evidence standard, not imported (Asia-EN evidence is the owner's step C decision). Root fix: the JP parser drops Bandai's new 入手情報 link labels (カードリスト, 商品情報), which made every entry name three products.

impacts.reason: New runbook module (scope, capture, uncoded report, plan digest, TCP-proxy checker, backup gate) and its reviewed scopes (eb-05, family-deck-set).
RUNBOOKS: catalogue-import as a collector-affecting write; --scope; scope validated in preflight.
Runbook choice and a scope input passed to both jobs. No secret, gate, permission or timeout change.

--series scope (coded only; refuses uncoded, unknown ids and repeated entry ids before connecting); keyword-only open_tunnel (ReroutedChecker: only the connection route changes) and on_plan seams; no change to planning, pins or the apply path.
collect_images(only_entry_ids=None): optional limit to the scope's entries; default unchanged.
Parser drops the 入手情報 link labels by exact match (raw getInfo kept verbatim); official-series-index's duplicate filter removed.
Scope, capture (series filter, scoped images, labels dropped), plan digest, proxy checker, apply gate and backup, uncoded report; importer --series scope and seams; parser labels.

resources: staging Postgres catalogue tables (release_products, canonical_cards, card_prints, release_product_aliases), only through an owner-approved ops-write apply
routes: GET https://www.onepiece-cardgame.com/cardlist/?series=<id> (about 64 pages) and the scope's card images, 1 per second
impact.deployment_impact: Merging changes nothing live. A dry run reads; an approved apply adds the scope's prints through the existing engine in one transaction.

recovery.procedure: Code: native revert PR with its own mission file. Data: the apply report lists every created row; restore from the Railway backup the apply required (under 24 h), or an owner-approved removal of those rows.
recovery.trigger: A wrong print, product or identity after an apply, or a planner/engine refusal that the dry run did not show.
recovery.backup: Railway Postgres volume backup under 24 hours old, checked before every apply.

verification.observation_window: catalogue-import eb-05 dry run, owner-approved apply, then official-series-index and web-smoke.
